hero.h1: Home Automation Installation for New Jersey Homes
hero.sub: Transform your home into a smarter, more convenient living space with custom home automation systems.

cards.h2: Pick the parts of home automation you want

items.p: One touch sets the room. Scenes for Away, Movie Night, and Good Morning.
Locks, sensors, and alerts you can check and set from your phone.
Music and video in any room, run from one app or one wall panel.

I was extremely happy with my choice of For-Tech for the purchase and installation of my home backup generator. From the initial salesman to the site survey to the electricians and plumbers who installed the equipment, the entire crew was very courteous and professional.

We had an excellent experience with For-Tech Electric during the installation of our full-house generator. From start to finish, the office team provided outstanding service with clear, consistent communication every step of the way. The installers were friendly, professional, and always on time.

For-Tech came highly recommended by several friends. Going in there was slight hesitation as it was from the higher quotes. BUT the best money ever spent. The service is impeccable,  reliable and genuine.

steps.p: We sit down with you and the owner and settle what each room controls.
Low-voltage wiring run neatly during construction, before the walls close.
Lighting, AV, security, and climate set up to work together from one app.
We stay on after move-in for changes, new scenes, and support.

about.p: For-Tech Electric designs lighting plans for custom homes and installs smart home systems and generators across New Jersey. Founder Yaakov Forchheimer opened For-Tech in 2009 to build a company around safety, reliability, and happy customers.
about.alt: For-Tech Electric's founder at his desk

services.h2: More we install in New Jersey homes

items.p: Home theaters and TVs, mounted and wired clean.
Alarm systems that alert you the moment something trips.
Cameras you can check from your phone.
Strong WiFi in every room of the house.
See who is at the door and let them in from anywhere.

items.q: Can home automation work in an existing home?
items.a: Yes. We install in new construction and in finished homes with little disruption.

items.q: What systems do you work with?
items.a: Lutron, Control4, Nest, Ring, and others, picked for what your home needs.
Many systems use low-voltage wiring, which we run cleanly and out of sight. Wireless works where it fits.

items.q: Can lighting, AV, and security be controlled together?
items.a: Yes. We design one system so a single app or wall panel runs all of it.
Yes. Lighting, audio, and security for patios, pools, and the outside of the house.

final.p: Tell us about your home or your project and pick a time.
